scope: Saved-state endpoint diagnosis; no qualification, configuration search, historical replay, or missing intermediate-state reconstruction
device: CUDA physical GPU1 only, float32 public optimizer probes; float64 raw-field finite differences
enumeration: All25 Cartesian real-word/prior-row pairs, equal weight; sigma0 finite5cloud; no sampling or noise
gradient_field: Each role's minimization gradient, D includes original BCAP; G/E/prior share original joint RpGAN loss; inputs recomputed at each perturbed state, detached exactly as in original role update
public_step: Original per-arm public float32 optimizer state, learning rates, truncation, smoothing, epsilon and sampled-row semantics; D first, then G/E/prior. Clone resets for every role mask
jacobian: Four-dimensional orthonormal projection along disjoint normalized role directions from first full sequential public step; central finite differences of RAW game field only, CUDA float64, h1e-3 and3e-4
jacobian_stability: Relative Frobenius difference <=.05; tiny projected norm<=1e-12 treated as uninformative; skew exceeding symmetric norm is local projected circulation, not chronic causal identification or normalized-step convergence proof
controls: No RNG streams consumed by numerical probes
Original clean served metrics matched in support/reconstruction
CUDA bilinear skew and quadratic symmetric finite-difference controls
Optimizer sampled rows all5 and actual normalized steps finite
Raw Cartesian expectation independently checked by 25 one-pair loss evaluations

predictions.support: Stable nonzero antisymmetric projected raw-field component, especially D vs other roles
predictions.limit: Projection and endpoints only; does not prove dominant historical failure cause

predictions.support: Nonvanishing actual steps despite weak raw gradients, with degraded exact-law quality even under frozen-D role probes
predictions.limit: T(E[g]) not E[T(g)]; one fixed finite probe cannot establish whole-run cause

predictions.support: Independent G/E/prior motions change encoded-to-generated correspondence or finite-row assignment from a common passing state
predictions.limit: Movement may be gauge-compatible; measure paired reconstruction and generation separately

stop_rule: Execute each endpoint once, no seed variants, retries, annealing, longer training, or qualification regrading; archive errors/null cases
historical_gif: Reuse actually scored training GIF from original smoothed truncated-serial source; no new training for media
checkpoint_loader_limit: Historical endpoint20001 exceeds recipe horizon20000. Public loader uses temporary20000 completed count, reinstates original20001 immediately, verifies complete policy packet digest; no scheduling or policy begin_step is called. Original checkpoint bytes retained.
